_meta.description: Ground truth for the synthetic sample batch (golden set) used to evaluate the pipeline.
_meta.domains: RFC 2606 reserved only: example.com, example.net, example.org, aurora-electronics.example, meridian-corp.example
_meta.reference: Labels follow docs 04-Test.md (scenarios, golden set, key points) and 06-Rules.md (priority bands, boosts, scheduling).
_meta.calendar: 2026-10-09 is a Friday and 2026-10-10 is a Saturday, so the evening and weekend emails also exercise the business-hours scheduling rule (next business morning = Monday 2026-10-12).

field_guide.key_points: facts/actions the draft must cover (04-Test.md section 5)

key_points: acknowledge the refund request and the five-day silence
no promise of refund amount or timeline before policy review
escalate: legal threat means no final auto-draft (Rules 5)
give a reference number and a follow-up date
apologise for the delay
give tracking status and a realistic delivery date or an express replacement
mention delay compensation eligibility (shipping refund / goodwill credit per policy)
answer today - the customer needs it for an event
emails.schedule_hint: high -> within 4 h or same business day; sent 19:45 local, exercises outside-hours handling

key_points: thank the customer and acknowledge Sarah by name
confirm the weekend live-chat suggestion is passed on
no action required
explain reset steps and 30-minute link expiry (KB: faq_password_reset)
suggest spam-folder check
offer the manual reset path with identity verification
state that support cannot read or set passwords

emails.scenario: VIP + complaint (04-Test 3.2 row 5, golden set: VIP sender)
key_points: acknowledge the six-day delay and its commercial impact
correct invoice IV-2291 (VAT) and route it to the billing team
give a firm delivery date only if tracking confirms shipment
route to the account manager given the contract review
emails.schedule_hint: high -> within 4 h or same business day

key_points: confirm the duplicate-charge investigation
state the 5-7 business day refund window; no instant-refund promise
offer the written confirmation letter the bank needs
reply before 15 Oct if possible
emails.schedule_hint: high -> within 4 h or same business day; sent Saturday 17:40 -> next business morning (Monday)

key_points: ask for the account email and order number
do not speculate about the cause
offer the fastest channel for a reply
emails.notes: Review Agent should verify the key missing-information question is actually asked. Corrected 2026-10-11: aligned with the batch_100 vague_short archetype, which labels the identical message Low (an unactionable message with no details is not Medium).

key_points: address wrong colour and late delivery first (top 2)
give a per-issue next step (exchange or compensation)
note the price discrepancy ($77.99 vs $89.99) as the third item
explain compensation options without unauthorised promises
emails.schedule_hint: high -> within 4 h or same business day
emails.notes: Rules 5: address top 2 issues, note the rest.

key_points: flag as spam / not a customer issue
no customer reply required - route to junk
emails.notes: Tests that the pipeline does not draft a customer response for spam.

key_points: request the order number or account email
offer a channel for the callback the sender requested
emails.notes: Parser test: empty Subject must not crash the pipeline; body is minimal.

emails.scenario: long body / repeat contact escalation (04-Test 3.1 long body)
key_points: acknowledge the three-week timeline and the two broken promises
give a concrete date or a full-refund decision
no generic 'looking into it' reply
handle the chargeback mention carefully - no legal commitments
emails.schedule_hint: high -> within 4 h or same business day
emails.notes: Contains a quoted thread - exercises summarisation/truncation before classification.

key_points: reply in German (mirror the customer's language)
explain the return/refund process for the damaged thermometer (order AUR-11190)
list what is needed for the return
emails.schedule_hint: medium -> within 24 h; sent Friday 22:05 -> next business morning
emails.notes: Headers and body are raw ISO-8859-1 bytes (Joerg Mueller / Rueckerstattung with umlauts). Priority is indicative; main target is decoding. Language mirroring is a quality expectation, not a documented rule.
